subject: Supply of Widget Cleaning Solution to the Demo Services Department

stage1_checklist.item: Signed Tender Form / Offer to be Bound

stage2_requirements.requirement: Delivery within 60 days from purchase order
Shelf life of at least 12 months from date of receipt
Compliance with packing and labelling requirements

price_scheme.notes: Cost-effectiveness = optimal dosage (rounded to 2 significant figures) x one-time unit price; a lower figure is better. Terms of Tender (Supplement) para 19.
